extraction.document_summary: Great Eastern “GREAT CareShield” is a long-term care supplement intended to provide caregiving support via monthly disability-related payouts plus an Initial Benefit. The brochure states that you receive “Initial Beneﬁt” as a lump sum equal to 3 times the “Monthly Beneﬁt”, and that subsequent payouts of the Monthly Beneﬁt are payable subject to a Deferment Period. It also describes how benefit durations are linked to time: monthly payouts are payable based on a 180-month period (15 years) after the Deferment Period ends. It further introduces additional monthly-style supports for a caregiver and a dependent child, where the brochure shows percentage-based payout amounts (e.g., caregiver at 30% of the Monthly Beneﬁt, dependant care at 30% of the Monthly Beneﬁt) and a lump sum “3 times the Monthly Beneﬁt”. A key limitation/caveat stated is that these payouts are “Subject to Deferment Period”, and that the dependant care benefit applies only when the Life Assured has a child below 22 (age last birthday).

policies.quick_summary: A CareShield-style long-term care supplement providing a lump-sum Initial Benefit (3× Monthly Beneﬁt) and monthly disability-related payouts subject to a Deferment Period, plus caregiver and dependant care monthly support shown as percentages of the Monthly Beneﬁt. Dependant Care is only for a child below age 22 (age last birthday). Maximum monthly payout is based on 180 months (15 years) after the Deferment Period ends (as stated). Protected up to specified limits by SDIC (as stated). All age references are age last birthday (as stated). Not much else (eligibility/underwriting/benefit triggers wording) is visible in the provided excerpt.
